name: Format Converter
description: Convert between JSON, JSON5, YAML, TOML, CSV, XML, INI and properties with auto detection and preserved key order
help: Choose “Auto detect” to paste any format; the detected format appears below the input.
Multi-document YAML (---) becomes an array; TOML date-times are kept as strings.
TOML has no null and needs a table at the top level; the exact path is reported when that happens.
For CSV pick the delimiter, whether the first row is a header and whether to infer numbers / booleans; nested objects become a.b columns when converting to CSV.

XML attributes map to @name; text becomes #text when an element also has attributes or children; repeated children become arrays and empty elements become null. A single child reads back as an object, not an array.
Dots in INI section names mean nesting ([server.tls]) and key[] = v builds arrays; properties keys are rebuilt into nested data from dots and [n] indexes and flattened to a.b[0].c on output.
JSON5 (comments, single quotes, trailing commas) is input only; choose JSON when you need JSON5 output.
placeholder: Paste JSON, YAML, TOML, CSV, XML, INI or properties…
waiting: The converted result appears here once you enter some input
